claims: Saturday Night Live's 51st season is the 2025–2026 season.
Kenan Thompson is returning for his 23rd season on Saturday Night Live.
Colin Jost and Michael Che are Weekend Update anchors on Saturday Night Live.

The returning veterans for Saturday Night Live's 51st season (2025–2026) are Kenan Thompson, Bowen Yang, Chloe Fineman, Mikey Day, Colin Jost, Michael Che, Marcello Hernández, Andrew Dismukes, James Austin Johnson, Sarah Sherman, Jane Wickline, Ashley Padilla.
Several new featured players joined Saturday Night Live in late 2025.
The new featured players who joined Saturday Night Live season 51 are Ben Marshall (formerly of Please Don't Destroy), Tommy Brennan, Jeremy Culhane, Kam Patterson, and Veronika Slowikowska.
Heidi Gardner, Ego Nwodim, Devon Walker, Michael Longfellow, and Emil Wakim departed Saturday Night Live.
John Higgins of Please Don't Destroy exited Saturday Night Live production to pursue other projects.
Ben Marshall joined the main cast of Saturday Night Live.
Saturday Night Live aired new episodes in early 2026.
Colman Domingo hosted Saturday Night Live in early 2026.
Noah Kahan was a musical guest on Saturday Night Live in early 2026.
